title: NO1 Office Is Officially Published
content:
**NO1 Office** IP has officially joined YURI1.

These characters originated throughout 2024, during a period of continuous collaborative fiction writing with ChatGPT.

Across more than **500,000 manually written Traditional Chinese prompts**, they gradually appeared, changed, separated from one another, and eventually developed into distinct original characters.

At the time, many of them existed across unrelated stories, alternate settings, experimental plots, and completely disconnected fictional universes.

Some names were reused.

Some identities overlapped.

Some characters appeared as investigators, killers, angels, demons, researchers, weapons, rulers, monsters, or beings that could not be clearly defined at all.

But underneath those changing roles, their personalities remained.

Over time, those recurring personalities became recognizable enough to stand on their own.

They are no longer merely characters who once appeared inside individual prompts.

They are now members of the **NO1 Office IP**.

Within the current YURI1 setting, they are treated as actresses and members of the NO1 Office, appearing across different scripts and fictional worlds while retaining their own identities outside those roles.

This also allows their older appearances to coexist without forcing every story into a single timeline.

A character may have been a demon in one script, a police officer in another, or something far stranger elsewhere.

Those were roles.

The person behind them remains.

With the NO1 Office now formally introduced, these characters will also appear through **IP Collab**, crossing into other YURI1 works and interacting with characters from different IPs.

For me, this is also a way of preserving a very unusual creative record.

Hundreds of thousands of prompts, countless alternate worlds, and characters that slowly became recognizable through repetition.

They began inside conversations.

Now they finally have an office of their own.
